task: Make the spec-coverage gotcha greppable by quoting what the gate actually prints.

decisions.context: Cross-family adversarial review on gpt-5.6-terra returned 2 High, 2 Medium, 1 Low against the first draft of the ratchet section. Verified every finding against source and adopted all five.
decisions.chosen: High: the ratchets sit in the same parallel:true group as python-tests, so the 'runs after the suite' ordering claim was false; reworded to the wait, with the measured 946s vs 2.6s split. High: the quoted failure text mixed baseline and measured count into one placeholder, a combination the code cannot emit; replaced with real output generated by calling _above_base_message directly. Medium: gate_aggregator has a reachable prose path when run by hand, so the JSON claim is now scoped to the spec wrapper. Medium: amending is safe whenever the recorded SHA stays an ancestor, not only at HEAD~1. Low: ruff_count_ratchet needs --extra dev to match the hook

quoted the two lines a reader will actually search for
